footer.tagline:
NuunPlatform — A Somali Learning Platform for Secondary Students

NuunPlatform is a Somali educational platform designed for secondary school students. It offers interactive practice, competitions, PDF resources, student groups, and more—all in one place. Our goal is to make learning more accessible, engaging, and effective for every student.

auth.register.phone_taken_alert: This phone number is already registered. Please login instead.
auth.help.title: Need Help?
auth.help.subtitle: Get in touch with the admin
auth.help.forgot_desc: Contact the admin on WhatsApp. They will help you reset it.
auth.help.unverified_desc: New accounts need admin approval. Message the admin to verify your account.
auth.help.other_desc: Any other account problems — the admin can help.
auth.help.no_admin: Admin contact is not configured. Please ask a teacher or school admin for help.
auth.help.response_time: The admin will respond within 24 hours.
error.404.title: Page Not Found
error.404.description: Oops! The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
error.404.sub: It might have been removed, renamed, or is temporarily unavailable.
error.500.title: Something Went Wrong
error.500.description: We're experiencing technical difficulties on our end.
error.500.sub: Our team has been notified and is working to fix the issue.
error.403.title: Access Denied
error.403.description: You don't have permission to view this page.
error.403.sub: If you think this is a mistake, please contact support.
error.maintenance.msg_default: We're performing scheduled maintenance. Please check back shortly.
error.maintenance.footer: Thank you for your patience — we'll be back online as soon as possible.
error.report.title: Report a Problem
error.report.subtitle: Help us fix this issue by telling us what happened.
error.report.description_label: What were you doing when this happened?
error.report.description_placeholder: e.g., I was trying to submit my practice answer and the page froze...
error.report.description_hint: Be as specific as possible. This helps us fix the issue faster.
error.report.email_hint: We'll only use this to follow up if we need more information.
admin.error.logged_note: This error has been logged and the admin has been notified.
